Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, and increased monocytes and basophils. Red cell distribution width is elevated, suggesting anisocytosis. Other parameters, including renal, liver, and electrolyte values, are within normal limits. Findings may indicate chronic disease, possible bone marrow dysfunction, or infection/inflammation; clinical correlation is recommended.
